description.value: Standing Spruce is an authentic Indigenous wellness brand and organic farm rooted in the traditional teachings of the Ligwiłda'xw peoples of Campbell River. The shop offers wild-harvested and wildcrafted products including skincare, plant medicines, candles, smudge sets, and hand-blended teas drawn from old-world Indigenous practices. A touring cyclist passing through Campbell River can browse a unique locally-rooted apothecary experience with deep cultural heritage.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Standing Spruce is an active Indigenous wellness brand and organic farm with a physical shop at 1066 Shoppers Row, Campbell River BC, and a farm at 2165 Shetland Rd, Campbell River BC. Phone 250-203-1699 and email are listed on the contact page. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM record has no address, phone, or osm_id tags — address and phone sourced entirely from website contact page.

OSM coordinates (lat 50.02638, lon -125.24496) place this near Campbell River, BC, which is consistent with the website address, but the exact pin location could not be verified against a street address.
U.S. shipping paused notice on website — does not affect physical store status but may affect online orders.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible retail shop in Campbell River with a confirmed physical address and active e-commerce presence; useful stop for touring cyclists seeking locally-made Indigenous wellness products.
enrichment_extras.notes: The business has two locations listed on the website: a shop at 1066 Shoppers Row and a farm at 2165 Shetland Rd, both in Campbell River, BC. The Shoppers Row address is the retail-facing location most relevant to touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: Ligwiłda'xw-rooted wellness shop and organic farm products; distinctive Indigenous-maker stop.
